title: Transparent Gothic gui
description: I'm prince of nether... Transparent and Gothic!
body:
# Unique gothic and transparent gui design with different animations.

If you want to remove the animation of the moon in the hotbar, then open the texture pack file along this path:

```
assets/minecraft/textures/gui/sprites/hud
```

and delete the **hotbar.png** file. Then rename **1hotbar.png** to **hotbar.png**
